name: XGuard
author: moelayyan90
description: Remote MCP discovery server for XGuard's x402 catalog, with read-only tools to discover paid HTTP/MCP resources, inspect exact resource records, and check live XGuard mainnet status.

tools.name: xguard_discover
tools.title: Discover x402 resources
tools.description: Search XGuard's x402 catalog or list recent entries. Returns matching HTTP or MCP resources.

query.description: Search phrase; omit to list recent resources.

type.description: Optional resource kind: http or mcp.

tools.name: xguard_resource_details
tools.title: Inspect x402 resource
tools.description: Look up one exact XGuard catalog resource by URL or key and return matching records.

resource.description: Exact resource URL or XGuard resource key.

tools.name: xguard_status
tools.title: XGuard status
tools.description: Return live XGuard mainnet gateway health and discovery statistics.
